title: Royal Flame — single-page premium restaurant homepage

requirements.summary: Build a single-page scrolling homepage with 10 ordered sections and anchor-based navigation targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders as a single scrolling page with all 10 requested sections present and visually separated.
Navbar links scroll to the correct section IDs (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Reservations, Contact).

file_operations.description: Create the single-page layout and render the sections in the required order with stable section IDs for in-page navigation (Hero, About, Featured Menu, Why Choose Us, Gallery, Testimonials, Reservations, Location, Footer).
Add a small composition module that exports the homepage sections in the required order to keep App.tsx readable and ensure section IDs match the navbar links.

requirements.summary: Implement a sticky responsive navbar with logo, anchor links, and a gold-accent Reservation CTA (mobile menu supported).
acceptanceCriteria: Navbar stays visible at the top while scrolling.
Reservation button uses gold highlight styling and stands out from the text links.
On mobile, navigation remains usable (e.g., collapses into a menu/drawer).

file_operations.description: Create a sticky top navbar with the generated logo (frontend/public/assets/generated/royal-flame-logo.dim_512x512.png), anchor links (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Reservations, Contact), and a right-aligned gold-accent Reservation button. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button + Sheet/Drawer) to support the mobile menu; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the Navbar component into the single-page homepage and connect its links/buttons to the correct section IDs.

requirements.summary: Implement the full-width hero with background image, dark overlay, exact heading text, and two CTA buttons that scroll to Menu/Reservations.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero background image is full-width with an overlay gradient to maintain text legibility.
Hero renders exactly the specified heading text.
Two CTA buttons are present with distinct primary/outline styling.
“Reserve a Table” scrolls to the Reservations section; “View Menu” scrolls to Featured Menu.

file_operations.description: Create the hero section using frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-interior.dim_2400x1350.jpg with a dark gradient overlay, heading text “Experience Fine Dining Like Never Before”, an emotional tagline, and two CTAs: primary gold “Reserve a Table” and outline “View Menu”. Use shadcn-ui Button for CTA styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure HeroSection is the first section and its CTAs scroll to the Reservations and Featured Menu section IDs.

requirements.summary: Implement the About split layout with image, story, and three highlights.
acceptanceCriteria: About section uses a two-column layout on desktop and stacks cleanly on mobile.
All three highlight items are displayed and readable.

file_operations.description: Create the About section with a responsive split layout: left image frontend/public/assets/generated/about-ambience.dim_1400x1000.jpg and right story paragraph plus highlight items (Fresh Ingredients, Award Winning Chefs, Cozy Atmosphere).
Wire AboutSection into the homepage and ensure its section ID matches the navbar’s About anchor.

requirements.summary: Implement Featured Menu with exactly 6 items in a responsive grid and premium hover shadow cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly 6 menu cards appear.
Each menu card contains image, title, description, and price.
Hover state adds a subtle premium shadow and/or lift effect (where hover is available).

file_operations.description: Create a Featured Menu section rendering exactly 6 menu cards in a responsive grid. Use images: frontend/public/assets/generated/menu-item-1.dim_1200x900.jpg through frontend/public/assets/generated/menu-item-6.dim_1200x900.jpg. Use shadcn-ui Card (or consistent Tailwind card styles) for premium visuals; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire FeaturedMenuSection into the homepage and ensure its section ID matches the navbar’s Menu anchor and the hero “View Menu” CTA target.

requirements.summary: Implement the Why Choose Us section with 4 icon-based feature tiles.
acceptanceCriteria: All four features are displayed with icons and labels.
Layout is responsive and maintains consistent spacing/alignment.

file_operations.description: Create the Why Choose Us section with 4 icon-based features (Premium Quality, Live BBQ, Private Dining Rooms, Fast Service). Use shadcn-ui utilities/components where helpful (e.g., Card) and a consistent icon approach; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire WhyChooseUsSection into the homepage in the required order.

requirements.summary: Implement a responsive Gallery grid with a lightbox overlay preview including next/previous and close controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Gallery displays a grid of images.
Clicking an image opens a lightbox overlay.
User can close the lightbox and navigate between images in the overlay.

file_operations.description: Create a responsive gallery grid using frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-1.dim_1400x1050.jpg through frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-8.dim_1400x1050.jpg and wire clicks to open a lightbox.

Implement a lightbox overlay with close + next/previous controls. Prefer shadcn-ui Dialog for the overlay shell and accessible focus handling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire GallerySection into the homepage and ensure its section ID matches the navbar’s Gallery anchor.

requirements.summary: Implement Testimonials as centered premium cards with review text and visible star ratings.
acceptanceCriteria: Each testimonial shows review text and a visible star rating.
Testimonials are presented in a centered, premium-looking card layout and remain readable on mobile.

file_operations.description: Create Testimonials section with centered card layout and a visible star rating for each testimonial. Use shadcn-ui Card for premium presentation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small StarRating display component (read-only) to render consistent star visuals for testimonials.

requirements.summary: Implement Reservations booking form with required fields, basic client-side validation, and an on-page success state after submit.
acceptanceCriteria: Form contains exactly the requested fields and a Reserve button.
Invalid submissions are blocked with inline validation feedback (e.g., required fields).
On successful submit, the user sees a confirmation message/state without a page reload.

file_operations.description: Create Reservations section with a booking form containing exactly: Name, Phone, Date, Time, Guests, plus a gold-accent “Reserve” button. Implement basic client-side validation and a success/confirmation state on submit (no page reload). Use shadcn-ui form inputs (Input/Select/Button) if available; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ReservationsSection into the homepage and ensure the navbar Reservation button and hero “Reserve a Table” CTA scroll to this section ID.

requirements.summary: Implement Location section with a map placeholder block and clear address/contact info.
acceptanceCriteria: A map placeholder block is visible and sized appropriately for desktop and mobile.
Address and contact info are displayed adjacent to or below the map placeholder.

file_operations.description: Create Location section with an embedded map placeholder area (non-interactive placeholder) and adjacent/stacked address + contact info for responsive layouts.
Wire LocationSection into the homepage and ensure its section ID matches the navbar’s Contact anchor.

requirements.summary: Implement a responsive Footer with four columns: About, Quick Links, Opening Hours, Social Media.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer contains four distinct columns with the requested headings.
On mobile, footer columns stack in a readable order with consistent spacing.

file_operations.description: Create the footer with 4 columns (About, Quick Links, Opening Hours, Social Media) and responsive stacking on mobile; ensure Quick Links use in-page anchors that match section IDs.
Wire Footer into the homepage as the last section (Footer) in the required order.

requirements.summary: Apply global brand styling: cream/white base, dark brown accents, gold highlights, serif headings, sans body, smooth scrolling, premium spacing/shadows, fully responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Global color palette reflects cream/white + dark brown + gold accent (no default/unstyled theme).
Headings use a serif font and body text uses a sans-serif font consistently.
Smooth scrolling is enabled for in-page navigation.
All sections are responsive with consistent spacing and premium-feeling shadows on cards/buttons where appropriate.

file_operations.description: Add global styles for brand palette (cream/white background, dark brown text/accents, gold highlights), typography (serif headings + sans body), base spacing defaults, and enable smooth scrolling for in-page navigation.
Extend Tailwind theme tokens (colors, fonts, shadows) to support the Royal Flame cream/dark-brown/gold brand styling consistently across sections.
Apply consistent layout primitives (containers, section spacing, card shadows, button variants) across all sections to match the requested premium, minimal luxury style.

acceptanceCriteria: All required images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated and load correctly in the UI.
Hero, About, Menu cards, and Gallery render using the generated images rather than broken links or empty placeholders.
Logo is displayed in the navbar using a generated image asset.
